svg.data-overall-dimensions: 12 x 19 x 1.75 in with the ears (datasheet; its mm column reads 305 x 228.6 x 44.45, the 228.6 a slip for 482.6); body modelled from CAD 440 x 45.0 x 300.1
svg.data-poe-budget-scope: using dual power; 220 W using single power
svg.data-poe-per-port: max per PSE: PoE 15.4 W, PoE+ 30 W, PoE++ 90 W; ports 11 and 12 of each line card are PoE++
svg.data-cooling: ten 40 x 20 mm fans behind the side-wall grilles, five per side
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: vendor optics line per the ReadyLinks Optics datasheet: SFP-1/10G-MM, SFP-1/10G-SM, SFP-1/10G-SM-SF-23 and -SF-32 (BiDi) 1/10G transceivers; no third-party support statement published
svg.data-layer-2: IGMP snooping; STP/RSTP with priorities and port-level disable; port isolation; storm control; voice VLAN; port mirroring; LACP; multicast/broadcast rate limiting; MAC blocking; flow control; 802.1X; jumbo frames; proprietary loop protection; DHCP snooping/guarding; egress rate limit; LLDP-MED; port restricted by MAC; device isolation with ACLs
svg.data-layer-3: DHCP server; IP routing; static routing between local networks; network isolation with ACLs
